title: NSW sustainable buildings context
text: NSW non-residential sustainability standards sit in Chapter 3 of the Sustainable Buildings SEPP. The official page was updated 19 June 2026. Residential development uses BASIX; Planning Portal announced BASIX tool upgrades on 1 May 2026. Applicability requires project-specific assessment. No BASIX target is converted directly into kWh savings. This prototype is not a compliance assessment.
